author: KSMGTA
quote: All I can say is that poor Rockstar fans have been deceived after 13 years of waiting. The game was delayed twice, promotional offers were minimal, and ultimately, it was a disaster both technically and narratively. They initially promised 60 FPS, but at release, they said only 30. However, the actual frame rate I and many other players worldwide saw was only 20. The game was heavily hyped and didn't deserve the fanfare. Games like Crimson Desert and AC Black Flag Resurrection weren't even nominated, and they're more playable than GTA 6. GTA 6 should rest in peace. It was a betrayal in the history of gaming; not just a betrayal of characters, but a betrayal of the company and everyone who waited for the game.
